transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I’ve felt this heavy, low mood every day for over a year, like I just can’t shake feeling down no matter what I do. It just feels like I'm completely stuck, and nothing I do seems to make a difference anymore.
Have you had any periods of feeling significantly better — where your mood improved and stayed better for several weeks or more — during this past year?

No, I haven't had any breaks from it at all. This heavy, depressed feeling has been constant and steady every single day for the past year, without any times where my mood actually lifted. It's just been a continuous weight.

Have you ever had a period of at least several days where you felt unusually energetic, irritable, or less in need of sleep — even briefly — during this time, or has your mood been consistently low without any manic or hypomanic symptoms?

No, my mood has been consistently low and heavy, and I've never had any periods of high energy or feeling "up." While I do lie awake at night with my mind racing, it's because of worry and stress, and it just leaves me feeling completely exhausted and drained rather than not needing sleep.
